description: This file defines a Java interface for interacting with Booking entities in a database using Spring Data JPA. It provides methods to find bookings by driver or vehicle.

classes.name: BookingRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Booking entities, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByDriver
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bookings associated with a specific driver.

methods.name: findByVehicle
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bookings associated with a specific vehicle.
